title.narrative: Strengthening Bangladesh Infrastructure Finance Fund Limited Project

description.narrative: The proposed project is a financial intermediation loan in an amount up to $50 million from Asian Development Bank (ADB)'s ordinary capital resources to Ministry of Finance for relending to Bangladesh Infrastructure Finance Fund Limited (BIFFL), for onlending to PPP infrastructure subprojects screened by Bangladesh Public Private Partnership (PPP) Authority and advised by ADB Office of Public Private Partnership (OPPP). The associated transaction technical assistance (TRTA) will strengthen BIFFL's institutional capacity and support project implementation. The objective of the proposed project is to facilitate long-term infrastructure finance and sustain infrastructure development in Bangladesh.

Status of Implementation Progress: The first PPP subproject - Dhaka Bypass Expressway is being financed. BIFFL has approved the subproject in 2019. Using ADB's credit line, BIFFL has onlent to the subproject worth around $36 million. BIFFL is also assessing the readiness of potential PPP subprojects to be considered for financing under this project.
BIFFL's institutional capacity to finance PPP infrastructure projects is being improved by (i) reviewing and updating BIFFL's business strategy, (ii) adopting a comprehensive capacity development plan for BIFFL, (iii) imparting necessary training to BIFFL's operations and safeguards staff to have increased knowledge related to safeguard compliance, (iv) establishing a functioning safeguards unit of BIFFL, and (v) imparting training to BIFFL staff to have increased awareness of gender-responsive infrastructure.
